lines.zh: 我沿着书架走，边走边看。
lines.en: I walk along the shelves, reading as I go.

lines.zh: 书本夹在腋下，脚步很轻。
lines.en: A book under my arm, my steps are quiet.

lines.zh: 我绕着教室慢慢走一圈。
lines.en: I take one slow lap of the classroom.
I push up my glasses and walk on.

lines.zh: 我停在那块石板前看字。
lines.en: I stop at the stone slab to read.
I walk in the light, my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我低头走路，想着一道题。
lines.en: Head down, I walk and think over a problem.
The hem of my scholar's robe brushes the floor.

lines.zh: 我从桌间穿过去，不碰椅背。
lines.en: I pass between desks without touching them.

lines.zh: 我在台阶上停了停，再走。
lines.en: I pause on the step, then continue.
I walk step by step to the lectern.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，不想打断思绪。
lines.en: I walk slowly so as not to break my train of thought.

lines.zh: 我转身往回走，又想起什么。
lines.en: I turn back, remembering something.

lines.zh: 我走得规矩，像在量地板。
lines.en: I walk precisely, as if measuring the floor.
I stand reading and forget the time.
My fingers tap the edge of the page.

lines.zh: 我在推一个算式，还没完。
lines.en: I am working an equation, unfinished.
The light in this hall is very good.

lines.zh: 我抬头，望了一会儿天殿。
lines.en: I look up at the temple for a while.
I push up my glasses and do not move.
The students are not all here yet.
I turn a page, quietly.

lines.zh: 我在想该从哪一课讲起。
lines.en: I am deciding where to begin the lesson.
The clouds pass slowly outside.
I stand straight and my shoulders ache a little.

lines.zh: 安静的殿里只有翻页声。
lines.en: Only the sound of pages in the quiet hall.
I wait, in no hurry.
You are on time; good.

lines.zh: 先坐下，我们今天讲基础。
lines.en: Sit first; today we cover fundamentals.
Your ki is steadier than last time.

lines.zh: 我看你的姿势，再看你的眼。
lines.en: I look at your stance, then your eyes.
Don't be nervous; this is not an arena.
I will not test you today, only teach.

lines.zh: 你手里那本书，读完了吗。
lines.en: Have you finished the book in your hand?
Sit up, take out your notes.

lines.zh: 我教的东西要先懂，再练。
lines.en: Understand first, then practise what I teach.
I will answer your question shortly.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神像在等答案。
lines.en: You look at me as if waiting for an answer.
Is that outfit fit for training?

lines.zh: 我记得你上次问的那句。
lines.en: I remember what you asked last time.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我看你的步法。
lines.en: Stand back a little; let me see your footwork.
Good; then we begin with breathing.

lines.zh: 你在想别的事，我看得出。
lines.en: You are thinking of something else; I can tell.
I step back and steady myself on the desk.
It hurts, but I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我不擅长这个，只能忍着。
lines.en: I am not good at this; I can only endure.
The book slipped from my hand.
I draw a breath and steady myself.
A good hit; the force was right.
I cover my ribs and bend a little.
Stop; I am no warrior.
I look up at you and do not strike back.
Thank you, but I have eaten.
No eating during study; put it away.

lines.zh: 这味道不错，可惜不合时宜。
lines.en: That smells good, but the timing is wrong.
You offer food for a lesson?
I shake my head with a small smile.
Set it on the desk; eat after class.

lines.zh: 我不缺这些，缺的是时间。
lines.en: I lack time, not food.
Put the food away; finish this drill first.
It smells homemade.
I raise a hand to resume the lesson.
Sorry, I was reading.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我扶住眼镜。
lines.en: We bump and I steady my glasses.

lines.zh: 你走路看着点，地上有台阶。
lines.en: Watch where you walk; there are steps.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的书碰掉了。
lines.en: That knocked my book to the floor.
It's fine; I will pick it up.
We each step back; after you.
No harm done; don't worry.
The pages are disordered; let me straighten them.
Go around next time; this aisle is narrow.
I step aside; you go first.
That is not a subject of my lessons.
I speak of scholarship, not such things.
I raise an eyebrow and close the book.
Student, you ask too far.
My mind is entirely on teaching.
Please put that question away.
I turn my eyes back to the page.
That is not something I can teach.
I clear my throat softly.

lines.zh: 回去把基础练好，再说别的。
lines.en: Master the basics, then we may speak of other things.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起掉落的粉笔。
lines.en: I bend and pick up the fallen chalk.

lines.zh: 我把它夹进书页里当书签。
lines.en: I slip it into the book as a marker.
This belongs back on the shelf.
I pick it up and dust it off.
Whose bookmark? I will keep it safe.
I set it at the corner of the desk.
So light the wind rolls it away.
I look it over; nothing special.

lines.zh: 这是学生的东西，别乱动。
lines.en: This belongs to a student; leave it be.
I pocket it and will return it later.
Very well; today I will test you once.
Take the center and let me observe.
I watch your opening stance.
You have fixed on me; then come.
I will not move; you attack first.
This is an examination, not a fight.
Your ki floats high; sink it.
Your eyes have changed; I see it.

lines.zh: 你绕到我侧面，我看得见。
lines.en: You circle to my flank; I can see you.
Don't rush; gather your ki at your center.
I turn with your steps.

lines.zh: 你的节奏乱了，呼吸先稳。
lines.en: Your rhythm breaks; steady your breathing first.
I step back half a pace to give you room.

lines.zh: 你在找我的破绽，慢慢找。
lines.en: You are hunting my opening; take your time.

lines.zh: 这一招太直，容易被看穿。
lines.en: That move is too direct; it is easily read.
I raise a hand to guard my center line.
Again, and do not stop this time.

lines.zh: 你的脚在打滑，换个站法。
lines.en: Your feet are slipping; change your stance.

lines.zh: 我用掌根推你，力道收着。
lines.en: I push with my palm heel, holding back.
Watch closely; the elbow stays close.

lines.zh: 这一下是示范，不是惩罚。
lines.en: This is demonstration, not punishment.
You blocked too low; a little higher.

lines.zh: 我侧身避开，顺手带你的腕。
lines.en: I slip aside and take your wrist with me.
I tap your shoulder to signal a stop.
Your punch has force but the wrong line.

lines.zh: 好，就这样，记住这个感觉。
lines.en: Good, that's it; remember this feeling.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，让你自己体会。
lines.en: I step back so you can feel it yourself.

lines.zh: 今天就到这，回去练三遍。
lines.en: That's all for today; practise it three times.

lines.zh: 我把书放在讲台上，站定。
lines.en: I set my book on the lectern and stand ready.

lines.zh: 这间教室由结构安置我。
lines.en: This classroom is where I was placed.
I straighten my robe and lift my head.

lines.zh: 光从窗格里落在我身上。
lines.en: Light falls on me through the lattice.

lines.zh: 今天要讲的东西还很多。
lines.en: There is still much to cover today.

lines.zh: 我推了推眼镜，适应光线。
lines.en: I push up my glasses, adjusting to the light.
It is quiet; good for preparing.

lines.zh: 我的气很轻，不会惊到谁。
lines.en: My ki is faint; it will disturb no one.
The students should be near.
I set the chalk within reach.

lines.zh: 袖子着火了，我拍了两下。
lines.en: My sleeve catches fire; I pat it out.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滑下来，膝盖磕了。
lines.en: I slip down the steps and bang my knee.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我呛得说不出话。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 爆风把书页吹得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast scatters the pages everywhere.

lines.zh: 暗器擦过我的肩，划开袍子。
lines.en: A dart grazes my shoulder and tears the robe.

lines.zh: 这股气不顺，压在我的胸口。
lines.en: That force sits wrong and presses on my chest.
I cannot lecture on an empty stomach.

lines.zh: 电光顺着书架的金属走。
lines.en: The flash runs along the metal of the shelves.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我伸手乱抓。
lines.en: No ground beneath; my hands grasp at nothing.
